prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1120; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the collision that occurred while our client was turning left at an intersection. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical treatment. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We ask that you provide a complete statement of the liability coverage limits under the policy issued to your insured, including any applicable excess or umbrella coverage, along with the declarations page. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this matter so that we may reference it in future correspondence.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dashcam or telematics data, vehicle event data recorder information, witness statements, recorded calls, claim file notes, and any repair or salvage records. Please ensure that none of this material is altered, discarded, or repaired until we have had an opportunity to inspect it.
